gancho: Encontró el mapa del tesoro del abuelo…
estilo: Cinematic Mexican telenovela look, warm dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, subtle 35mm film grain, emotional close-ups, realistic people, natural Mexican Spanish acting
escenas: Dusty attic lit by a small window, old boxes everywhere. PAOLA (20, long braid, denim overalls) opens an old wooden box and unfolds a yellowed letter, eyes widening as she reads aloud: "Si lees esto, el dinero está enterrado bajo el naranjo."

Same dusty attic. Her MOTHER (50, short dark hair, floral blouse) climbs up the ladder and sees PAOLA (20, long braid, denim overalls) holding the letter. The mother gasps: "¡Paola! ¿De dónde sacaste esa carta?" Paola shows it excitedly.

Same attic. The MOTHER (50, short dark hair, floral blouse) reads the letter, goes pale and sits on a box next to PAOLA (20, long braid, denim overalls). The mother whispers: "Ese naranjo… tu papá lo cortó ayer para hacer la cochera." Both stare at each other, then look out the window.
caption: El tesoro del abuelo estaba ahí… hasta ayer 🍊😭 #novela #drama #historiascortas #telenovela #giro
